entries.title: Responsive Layout
changes: Improved the main app layout for iPad and smartphone screen sizes.
Added phone-friendly quiz controls, larger tap targets, and compact navigation.
Improved Search and Statistics page layouts on narrow screens.
Tightened results and review layouts for mobile use.

entries.title: Question Explanations
changes: Added optional explanations and source references to question data.
Added an Explanation control in Test mode for questions that include supporting text.
Disabled in-session explanations during ST mode while keeping explanations available in final review.
Updated Question Search previews to show explanations and references.

entries.title: Local Statistics
changes: Added a dedicated Statistics page.
Completed test sessions now save locally in the browser.
Added overall averages, subject performance, recent attempts, and study time.
Added export, import, and clear controls for local statistics.
Added a Statistics button to the main menu.

entries.title: Framework Update
changes: Refactored and cleaned legacy code throughout the application.
Improved overall project structure and maintainability.
Moved Question Search to a dedicated search page.
Completely redesigned the Search interface.
Redesigned Search and Navigation buttons.
Added a scrollable changelog panel with custom styling.
Improved layout consistency across the application.
Fixed duplicate theme controls and UI inconsistencies.
Enhanced framework readiness for future features and pages.

entries.title: Cleanup build
changes: Consolidated legacy patch scripts into direct fixes.
Added one unified theme/search utility script.
Made answer text clickable.
Reduced duplicate theme, feedback, and search logic.

entries.title: SERA update
changes: Added a subject for EASA SERA Rules, this will cointan questions regarding everything contained in SERA

entries.title: Technical update
changes: Added a subject for Cessna Technical Course, this will cointan questions regarding SOP's, POH, Checklist's and more

entries.title: Infrastructure update
changes: Split the large question database into one JSON file per subject
Added subjects.json index for easier editing and maintenance
Updated app loading flow to build the bank from modular subject files
Removed the Met Kahoot subject from the modular build
Added more resilient modular question-bank loading

entries.title: Mental math update
changes: Added Mental Math as a selectable subject
Added questions for mental math
Added ST mode for mental math

entries.title: OPS update
changes: Updated OPS DB

entries.title: General update / fixes
changes: Edited the question DB, updated some typos in the questions

entries.title: Changelog panel
changes: Replaced Notes with read-only Changelog card on the main menu
Changelog loads from external changelog.json

entries.title: Notes restored
changes: Restored Notes panel to right column in main menu grid
Added localStorage auto-save for notes

entries.title: Header search button
changes: Moved 'Search for a question' button into the title row (flush right)
Updated version label

entries.title: Search feature iterations
changes: Added dedicated Search page accessible from main menu button
Status line + 'Build index now' + simple fallback search
UI placement refinements
